items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Revenue is supported only for 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. Site-attributed commission is $0 because the aggregate row cannot be assigned without inventing attribution. AI usage is $966.82985915 across 5,417 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26, conflicting with a prior record of $963.5690377 and 5,390 calls. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable: revenue and cost windows are misaligned, period-aligned domain/infrastructure/labor/marketing costs are absent, incremental outcomes are not isolated, and monthly spend, marketing, revenue-target, and revenue-floor limits are blank. Do not authorize discretionary spend, commitments, monetization expansion, forecasts, requeues, or new production work. Continue existing source-dated measurement and reconciliation only. Minimum finance measurement is one reconciled ledger covering hosting, domains, labor, marketing, experiments, and AI costs aligned to the revenue window; resolve the conflicting AI records; map site/content identifiers to attributable commission; isolate incremental outcomes; and record owner-approved spending and revenue limits before reporting margin, ROI, payback, or cost-to-learn. Clicks, impressions, sessions, conversions, technical scores, ordered items, and shipped items are not financial return without attributable commission and aligned costs.

Retain containment-only execution. Continue existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, failed-work repair-or-close review, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Do not create duplicate finance requests or telemetry; use the existing reconciliation workstream and preserve unknown margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure cost, and budget exposure.
